title: Production data platform must be zone redundant
context: The production data platform serves the customer-facing API. A single-zone outage in the primary region must not take the platform down.
decision: Every production data-platform resource that can be zone redundant is zone redundant: SQL databases, storage accounts, PostgreSQL flexible servers, Cosmos DB accounts.
decisionDrivers: Availability target of 99.95 percent for the API
Zone-level failure is the most frequent regional incident class
consequences: Higher SKU cost on SQL and PostgreSQL
constraints: No cross-region failover in this decision
assumptions: All production data-platform resources carry the tag env=prod
risks: Resources created outside the platform's pipeline may drift

claims.statement: Production data-platform resources are zone redundant
